excluded_attempts.classification: New test assumed an original decoded Memo exceeded 4096 bytes. Three tests passed; the Memo test failed this authoring assertion before its payload checks. Replaced only that size assumption with nonempty Text; exact LVAL visit multiset, read reduction and corruption expectations remained unchanged. No production correction.

contracts: Initial complete sequential scalar decoding and its full schema/object/definition/count checks remain required.
Each qualified logical index uses existing complete All projection traversal; every key component remains decoded and compared with the physical index entry.
Key-only returned cells map original logical positions through a bounded private KeyRow view for unchanged unique/required/NULL checks.
Original USysRibbons data proves exact equality of optimized LVAL page-visit counts with a standalone sequential pass, and fewer total bytes/LVAL visits than full decoding per index.
Corruption of a counted non-key LVAL page remains rejected by the initial sequential pass.
Gapped/reversed ACE 16 composite keys retain constraints, including typed duplicate-key and required-NULL failures.
Existing unsupported-profile coverage, extra-live-root rejection, selected corruption, I/O failures and cumulative budgets remain covered by the focused regressions.
limits: Local Rust and existing authored/original fixture evidence, not native Microsoft Access integrity qualification.
No concurrent-file snapshot or arbitrary mutation detection guarantee; callers still supply stable/offline sources.
No new index profiles, constraints, default allowances, automatic fallback or write eligibility.
No full workspace suite or timing claim. CLI integration and original-file replay are separate.
source_snapshot_scope: Final reviewed working-tree files before logical commit; not an executable compilation manifest.
